import html # Predefined format for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}

""" def publish_blog_article(subject: str, description: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a user‑submitted blog post. Args: subject: The title of the blog post. description: The main text content of the blog post. Returns: A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post, safe for rendering in an HTML page. Raises: ValueError: If either subject or description is empty. """ if not subject or not description: raise ValueError("Subject and description must be non‑empty strings.") # Escape HTML to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(subject, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content using the template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
